messages:
jules (sales): Heads up, BetaBank's POC just failed their CI checks. They pinned `rw-legal-13b-v3` but it's not available in eu-central. Demo in 24h. Need options fast.
marco (solutions): do we have a compatible build in-region?
rina (infra): we have `rw-legal-13b-v2` and a quantized `rw-legal-13b-q8` in eu-central. v3 wasn't onboarded to EU due to a rollout flag.
tess (security): BetaBank has strict residency rules. No logs or model weights may leave eu region. Temporary exception requires explicit legal signoff and their KMS ARN.
oliver (eng-runtime): functionally v2 matches most prompts but there are whitespace/token differences that break exact-match tests. Quantized q8 changes probabilities more.
jules (sales): client insists on exact-match for compliance demo. Any way to make v3 available in eu for the trial?
rina (infra): fastest path: promote v3 to eu via a one-off replication job. Needs a 2hr maintenance window and storage quota check.
oliver (eng-runtime): alternatively, we can alias the model id to point at a compatible variant but that won't satisfy their compliance team if weights are outside region.
jules (sales): pricing/legal question: will cross-region replication or temporary hosting incur extra fees?
rina (infra): replication bandwidth billed; for a single short trial we can waive charges up to a cap. Need approval from finance.
tess (security): if we replicate, ensure KMS keys are EU-resident or customer provides their key. I'll start drafting the addendum template.
omar (ops-bot): [NOTICE] TICKET-5507 opened for BetaBank POC region pin issue. Assigned infra + eng-runtime + security.
oliver (eng-runtime): I can script the replication and smoke tests. Estimate 3 hours including rollback plan. Need green light from finance + customer's KMS ARN.
marco (solutions): propose options to BetaBank: 1) Onboard v3 to eu (3hr, slight downtime window) with KMS & addendum. 2) Demo with v2 in-region and run a diff report to show parity risk. Offer to waive replication fees up to 150 EUR.
jules (sales): thanks. I'll message them with both options and request KMS ARN + decision ASAP. I'll update TICKET-5507 with their reply.
